title: design-delta design-side token snapshot
description: The second of D7's two design-side snapshot files (`design-tokens.json`), written by `design-delta ingest --tokens` from a provider's raw gather envelopes, read by `audit`/`verify`. Provider-agnostic (ADR-001 D12) — one entry per distinct variable NAME the provider observed bound somewhere across the gathered nodes, deduplicated project-wide (ADR-003 Phase 5.3: census scope has no per-file attribution, matched by name candidate first — ADR-003 Amendment 4 — and by value as coverage). Every snapshot is optional and degrades like missing if invalid (ADR-001 D7); this file is never hand-authored.

tokens.description: One entry per distinct variable name observed across every gathered node, deduplicated (first occurrence wins in gather-target order).

provenance.description: When and how this snapshot was gathered (issue #389) — kept from the raw envelopes by `ingest`, never from the clock, so a report can state whether it rests on a fresh gather or a months-old committed file. Absent on a snapshot written before this field existed.

gatheredAt.description: The newest `gatheredAt` across the envelopes that ingested — a gather is as fresh as its newest file.

planHash.description: The `gather` plan every ingested envelope was produced from; absent when they disagree.

providerVersion.description: The provider version every ingested envelope reported; absent when they disagree.

engineVersion.description: The design-delta version that normalized this snapshot (issue #458). Normalization runs at `ingest`, so stored values are only as current as this engine; `audit` compares it against the provider's `normalizationSince`. Absent on a snapshot written before 0.19.0.

name.description: The provider's own variable or style name/path — opaque to the rest of the engine (ADR-001 D12). Matched by NAME CANDIDATE first (ADR-003 Amendment 4), by value as coverage.

value.description: The resolved value as a comparable string — the default mode's value for a variable, a deterministic rendering for a text style. Always present, so a reader from before issue #380 still works; the structured fields below are what a reader after it compares.

kind.description: What the provider observed (issue #380). Absent on a snapshot written before it, which is a variable.

values.description: A variable's typed value per mode NAME: a hex color, a number, a string, a boolean, or `{alias}` when the alias could not be resolved. What `tokens/design-token-mismatch` compares mode by mode, and what `tokens/design-mode-missing` reads the design side's mode vocabulary from (issue #404) — absent (a snapshot gathered before issue #380's structured path), the comparison degrades to the single folded `value` above and no mode finding is raised.

aliasOf.description: The variable this one aliases, by name (or provider id when the target was not in the same gather).

style.description: A text style's structured fields, units carried where the provider has them.

unit.description: `PIXELS`, `PERCENT`, or `AUTO` — the provider's own unit, never inferred.
